lines.text: The apostles performed many signs and wonders, and all the sick who were brought to them were healed.
After someone reported the apostles teaching in the temple courts, the high priest brought them gently for fear of the people.
A Pharisee named Gamaliel reminded the Council of Theudas and Judas Iscariot, and urged leaving the apostles alone.

problems.problem: Its wrong detail "because an angel warned him" is 5 words. Swap one short detail (4 words or fewer, like a name, place or number) and list only the swapped words.
